metadata.name: openpump_amm
metadata.description: OpenPump constant-product AMM: graduated coins trade here (clean-room, PumpSwap-shaped)

instructions.name: admin_cto_pool
docs: Protocol: community takeover of a pool's coin creator (mirrors the curve's admin_cto).

instructions.name: boost_buy_and_burn
docs: Boost authority: spend vault quote back into the pool and burn the base it buys (price goes up).

instructions.name: buy
docs: Buy an exact amount of base tokens, paying at most `max_quote_amount_in` (fees included).
`track_volume`: count the quote spent toward the shared volume-incentive campaign (SOL pools, both accumulators passed).

accounts.name: fee_config
docs: Optional: the fees program's tiered schedule (market-cap based).

accounts.name: buyback_fee_recipient_token_account
docs: Optional: quote ATA of `global_config.buyback_fee_recipient`; receives the buyback share of the protocol fee.

instructions.name: buy_exact_quote_in
docs: Spend up to `spendable_quote_in` (fees included) for as much base as that buys; at least `min_base_amount_out`.

accounts.name: fee_config
docs: Optional: the fees program's tiered schedule (market-cap based).

accounts.name: buyback_fee_recipient_token_account
docs: Optional: quote ATA of `global_config.buyback_fee_recipient`; receives the buyback share of the protocol fee.

instructions.name: collect_coin_creator_fee
docs: The coin creator sweeps everything in their vault for `quote_mint` into their own ATA.

accounts.name: creator
docs: Owner of the initial liquidity. May be a PDA of another program (the curve) signing via CPI.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent for the new accounts (the curve passes the migrating user here).

accounts.name: locked_lp_token_account
docs: Holds MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY LP forever (owned by the pool PDA, which never signs a burn/transfer of it).

accounts.name: coin_creator_vault_ata
docs: Created here so buy/sell never need to init accounts.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Token program for the LP mint (classic SPL Token).

instructions.name: disable
docs: Kill switch. Bits: 1 create_pool, 2 deposit, 4 withdraw, 8 buy, 16 sell.

instructions.name: distribute_coin_creator_fees
docs: Permissionless: split a sharing-config coin creator's vault among its shareholders
(remaining accounts: wallets..., then their quote ATAs...).

instructions.name: extend_account
docs: Grow a GlobalConfig / Pool account created by an older program version to the current layout
(new fields read as zero). Permissionless; the payer covers the rent delta.

instructions.name: init_boost
docs: Move part of a freshly migrated pool's quote into its boost vault without moving the price
(the pool keeps counting it as virtual quote). Only migration pools with no LP holders.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the vault's rent.

instructions.name: multi_hop_swap
docs: Route through up to 4 pools in one instruction (see multihop.rs for the remaining-accounts layout).

instructions.name: sell
docs: Sell an exact amount of base tokens, receiving at least `min_quote_amount_out` (after fees).

accounts.name: fee_config
docs: Optional: the fees program's tiered schedule (market-cap based).

accounts.name: buyback_fee_recipient_token_account
docs: Optional: quote ATA of `global_config.buyback_fee_recipient`; receives the buyback share of the protocol fee.

instructions.name: set_coin_creator
docs: The current coin creator hands the fee stream to another address (e.g. a fees-program sharing PDA).

instructions.name: set_coin_creator_fee_bps
docs: Coin creator sets the pool's creator fee (0 = schedule) within the ceiling; `lock` makes it final.

instructions.name: toggle_mayhem_mode
docs: Allow pools to be created in mayhem mode (migration pools inherit the curve's flag regardless).

instructions.name: update_boost_config
docs: Share of a migration pool's quote (bps) moved into its boost vault by `init_boost`.

instructions.name: update_buyback_config
docs: Share of the protocol fee (bps) routed to the buyback recipient's quote ATA on every direct swap.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: SharingMismatch
errors.msg: Sharing config does not match this pool

errors.name: RecipientsMismatch
errors.msg: Shareholders and remaining accounts do not match

errors.name: HolderRewardCreatorImmutable
errors.msg: The creator of a holder-reward pool cannot be changed

errors.name: CreatorFeeLocked
errors.msg: Creator fee is locked for this pool

errors.name: AlreadyBoosted
errors.msg: Pool already has a boost in flight

errors.name: NotMigrationPool
errors.msg: Only migration pools can be boosted

errors.name: BoostInProgress
errors.msg: Liquidity is locked while a boost is in flight

errors.name: InvalidAccount
errors.msg: Not an account of this program

errors.name: AlreadyExtended
errors.msg: Account already has the current layout

fields.name: flat_fees
docs: Used when no tier applies / for foreign pools.

fields.name: fee_tiers
docs: SOL-quoted coins (sorted ascending by threshold).

fields.name: stable_fee_tiers
docs: Coins quoted in a stable mint listed in `stable_mints`.

fields.name: exotic_flat_fees
docs: Any other quote mint (custom pairs).

fields.name: market_cap_lamports_threshold
docs: Market cap (in quote base units, i.e. lamports for SOL) from which this tier applies.

fields.name: mayhem_mode_enabled
docs: Pools may be created in mayhem mode by non-migration callers.

fields.name: buyback_basis_points
docs: Share of the protocol fee (bps) sent to `buyback_fee_recipient`'s quote ATA on direct swaps.

fields.name: boost_authority
docs: Boost: migration pools park `boost_basis_points` of their quote in a vault the authority spends on buy-and-burns.

fields.name: protocol_fees
docs: Lifetime stats (informational).

fields.name: creator_fee_bps
docs: Per-pool creator fee override (bps). 0 = follow the schedule.

fields.name: virtual_quote_reserves
docs: Quote parked in the boost vault but still priced as if in the pool (see boost.rs).

types.name: SharingConfig
docs: Per-coin creator fee split. When a coin's `creator` is this PDA, its creator fees accrue in the
PDA's creator vault and `distribute_creator_fees` (curve / AMM) pays the shareholders.
